Hootsuite

Give social publishing a shared process and clear accountability.

HOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Hootsuite supports social publishing, team collaboration, and analysis across supported channels. MoreSpace can structure a practical social operating system around content planning, approvals, publishing ownership, and performance review so international campaign teams maintain a coherent customer-facing presence.

Useful outputs

  • A shared publishing calendar and reviewed channel-specific post drafts
  • Clear approval responsibilities and documented publishing handoffs
  • Social performance views with practical content improvement recommendations

Where we can apply it

  • Campaign brief → reviewed asset variants → shared calendar → approved publication.
  • Editorial draft → assigned reviewer → final approval → channel publishing handoff.
  • Social performance → website outcome review → content insights → next campaign brief.
01

Use case 1

Organize a shared publishing calendar with channel-specific content variants.

02

Use case 2

Build review responsibilities and approved team handoffs for social assets.

03

Use case 3

Compare available social performance with campaign objectives and website activity.

Inputs we need

  • Approved content themes, brand rules, and regional campaign objectives
  • Authorized social channels, user roles, and publishing responsibilities
  • Asset inventory, review stages, and agreed performance measures

Delivery sequence

  • Map campaign priorities and channel requirements into a clear editorial calendar.
  • Configure permitted team roles and test the reviewed publishing workflow.
  • Publish approved assets and compare available engagement with campaign outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve final post content, claims, and publication destinations before scheduling.
  • Verify team permissions and preserve vendor brand assets according to their terms.
